# KOV Career Agency

> Founder-led career representation and individual career services for professionals, including senior leaders pursuing a considered next career move.

KOV provides candidate-side career support. Scope, deliverables, fees, approvals and reporting are agreed before work begins. Employers control their hiring decisions. KOV does not guarantee interviews, job offers, employment or timelines.

## Primary pages
- [KOV Career Agency](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/): Overview of private career representation and individual career services.
- [Private Career Representation](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/services.html): Candidate-side search strategy, target research, approved outreach and follow-up.
- [Individual Career Services](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/candidate-services.html): Resume, LinkedIn, career documents, portfolios, positioning and coaching.
- [How It Works](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/how-it-works.html): KOV's service process and engagement stages.
- [Pricing](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/pricing.html): Scope-based service information and written terms.
- [About KOV](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/about.html): Founder and agency background.
- [Contact](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/contact.html): Contact KOV about services and representation.
- [Executive Roles](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/roles/): Role-based career representation guides.
- [Industries](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/industries/): Industry-focused career representation guides.
- [Countries We Serve](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/countries-we-serve.html): Geographic service coverage.
- [Markets](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/markets/executive-job-search-dubai.html): Examples of market-specific executive career support.
- [Blog](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/blog.html): Career search and professional positioning insights.
- [Case Studies](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/resources/case-studies.html): Examples of KOV's career-search approach.
- [Glossary](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/glossary.html): Definitions used in career representation and executive job searches.
- [FAQ Library](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/faq/index.html): Detailed answers about KOV's services, process, fees and policies.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/privacy.html): Privacy, data use and retention information.

## Complete discovery resources
- [Full indexable page directory](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/llms-full.txt): Expanded page descriptions and links for the current canonical, indexable site.
- [XML sitemap](https://www.kovcareeragency.org/sitemap.xml): Search-engine sitemap of canonical, indexable production pages.

Only canonical, indexable production pages are listed in the sitemap and full page directory. Staging pages and pages explicitly marked noindex are intentionally excluded.
